119	    if not _is_plain_int(actual_carbon) or actual_carbon < 0:
120	        raise ValueError("completion request actual_carbon must be a "

123	            "actual_cost": actual_cost, "actual_carbon": actual_carbon}

126	def _validate_record(
127	    record: object,
128	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
129	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] | None = None,
130	) -> dict[str, Any]:
131	    if not isinstance(record, dict) \
132	            or set(record.keys()) != set(_RECORD_FIELDS):
133	        raise ValueError("completion record has invalid fields")
134	    job_id = record["job_id"]
135	    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
136	        raise ValueError("completion job_id must be a non-empty string")
137	    at = record["at"]
138	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
139	        raise ValueError("completion at must be a non-boolean non-negative "
140	                         "integer")
141	    outcome = record["outcome"]
142	    if outcome not in _OUTCOMES:
143	        raise ValueError("completion outcome is invalid")
144	    actual_cost = record["actual_cost"]
145	    actual_carbon = record["actual_carbon"]
146	    if not _is_plain_int(actual_cost) or actual_cost < 0:
147	        raise ValueError("completion actual_cost must be a non-boolean "
148	                         "non-negative integer")
149	    if not _is_plain_int(actual_carbon) or actual_carbon < 0:
150	        raise ValueError("completion actual_carbon must be a non-boolean "
151	                         "non-negative integer")
152	    generation = record["generation"]
153	    if not _is_plain_int(generation) or generation < 0:
154	        raise ValueError("completion generation must be a non-boolean "
155	                         "non-negative integer")
156	    current = _validate_selection(record["current"])
157	    cost_exceeded = record["cost_exceeded"]
158	    carbon_exceeded = record["carbon_exceeded"]
159	    if not isinstance(cost_exceeded, bool) \
160	            or not isinstance(carbon_exceeded, bool):
161	        raise ValueError("completion limit flags must be booleans")
162	
163	    # With the business snapshots in hand the frozen references and
164	    # flags are revalidated exactly as the other ledgers revalidate
165	    # theirs.
166	    if accepted is not None:
167	        job = accepted.get(job_id)
168	        if job is None:
169	            raise ValueError("completion record must reference an accepted "
170	                             "job")
171	        if cost_exceeded != (actual_cost > job["max_cost"]):
172	            raise ValueError("completion cost_exceeded does not match the "
173	                             "job's original cost upper bound")
174	        if carbon_exceeded != (actual_carbon > job["carbon_cap"]):
175	            raise ValueError("completion carbon_exceeded does not match "
176	                             "the job's original carbon upper bound")
177	    if history is not None:
178	        published = history.get(current["resource_id"])
179	        if published is None or current["version"] > len(published):
180	            raise ValueError("completion current must reference a "
181	                             "published resource version")
182	    return {
183	        "job_id": job_id,
184	        "at": at,
185	        "outcome": outcome,
186	        "actual_cost": actual_cost,
187	        "actual_carbon": actual_carbon,
188	        "generation": generation,
189	        "current": current,
190	        "cost_exceeded": cost_exceeded,
191	        "carbon_exceeded": carbon_exceeded,
192	    }

195	def _validate_ledger(
196	    data: object,
197	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
198	    history: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] | None = None,
199	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
200	           dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
201	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_ROOT_FIELDS):
202	        raise ValueError("completion ledger root must be an object with "
203	                         "keys version, completions, idempotency and audit")
204	    if not _is_plain_int(data["version"]) or data["version"] != _VERSION:
205	        raise ValueError("unsupported completion ledger version")
206	    records_raw = data["completions"]
207	    idempotency_raw = data["idempotency"]
208	    audit_raw = data["audit"]
209	    if not isinstance(records_raw, dict) \
210	            or not isinstance(idempotency_raw, dict) \
211	            or not isinstance(audit_raw, dict):
212	        raise ValueError("completions, idempotency and audit must be "
213	                         "objects")
214	    _check_sorted_keys(records_raw, "completions")
215	    _check_sorted_keys(idempotency_raw, "idempotency")
216	    _check_sorted_keys(audit_raw, "audit")
217	
218	    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
219	    completed_jobs: set[str] = set()
220	    for key, record_raw in records_raw.items():
221	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
222	            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
223	        record = _validate_record(record_raw, accepted, history)
224	        if record["job_id"] in completed_jobs:
225	            raise ValueError("a job can only be completed once")
226	        completed_jobs.add(record["job_id"])
227	        records[key] = record
228	
229	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
230	    for key, request_raw in idempotency_raw.items():
231	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
232	            raise ValueError("idempotency keys must be non-empty strings")
233	        request = _validate_request(request_raw)
234	        if key not in records:
235	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry must reference a recorded "
236	                             "completion")
237	        record = records[key]
238	        if any(request[field] != record[field] for field in _REQUEST_FIELDS):
239	            raise ValueError("idempotency entry does not match its "
240	                             "completion record")
241	        idempotency[key] = request
242	
243	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
244	    for key, event_raw in audit_raw.items():
245	        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
246	            raise ValueError("audit keys must be non-empty strings")
247	        if not isinstance(event_raw, dict) \
248	                or set(event_raw.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
249	            raise ValueError("completion audit event has invalid fields")
250	        if event_raw["key"] != key or not isinstance(event_raw["key"], str):
251	            raise ValueError("audit event key does not match its map key")
252	        request = _validate_request(event_raw["request"])
253	        if request != idempotency.get(key):
254	            raise ValueError("audit event does not match its idempotency "
255	                             "entry")
256	        result = _validate_record(event_raw["result"], accepted, history)
257	        if result != records[key]:
258	            raise ValueError("audit event result does not match its record")
259	        events[key] = {"key": key, "request": request, "result": result}
260	
261	    if set(events) != set(records) or set(idempotency) != set(records):
262	        raise ValueError("completion sections do not match")
263	    return records, idempotency, events

266	def _canonical_bytes(
267	    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
268	    idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
269	    events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
270	) -> bytes:
271	    # Compact UTF-8 JSON, non-ASCII written through, sections in their
272	    # fixed field order and all sections keyed by idempotency key in
273	    # code-point order, terminated by exactly one newline.
274	    payload = {
275	        "version": _VERSION,
276	        "completions": {key: records[key] for key in sorted(records)},
277	        "idempotency": {key: idempotency[key] for key in sorted(idempotency)},
278	        "audit": {key: events[key] for key in sorted(events)},
279	    }
280	    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False,
281	                      separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n"
282	    return text.encode("utf-8")

285	def _load_completion_ledger(
286	    realpath: str,
287	    accepted: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None,

289	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
290	           dict[str, dict[str, Any]], bytes | None]:

292	        data: object,
293	    ) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
294	               dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
295	        return _validate_ledger(data, accepted, history)
296	
297	    def canonical(
298	        sections: tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
299	                        dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
300	                        dict[str, dict[str, Any]]],
301	    ) -> bytes:
302	        records, idempotency, events = sections
303	        return _canonical_bytes(records, idempotency, events)
304	
305	    sections, raw = _lifecycle.load_canonical(
306	        realpath, "completion ledger", validate, canonical)
307	    if sections is None:
308	        return {}, {}, {}, None
309	    records, idempotency, events = sections
310	    return records, idempotency, events, raw

336	def _record_for_job(
337	    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
338	    job_id: str,

346	def complete(
347	    jobs: str,
348	    supply: str,
349	    signals: str,
350	    trades: str,
351	    dispatch: str,
352	    execution: str,
353	    completions: str,
354	    job_id: str,
355	    key: str,
356	    at: int,
357	    outcome: str,
358	    actual_cost: int,
359	    actual_carbon: int,
360	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
361	    """Register the terminal completion of one finished job.
362	
363	    The six business paths and the independent ``completions`` ledger
364	    path, ``job_id`` and ``key`` must be non-empty strings resolving to
365	    seven distinct real locations; ``at`` must be a non-boolean
366	    non-negative integer, ``outcome`` exactly ``succeeded`` or
367	    ``failed`` and ``actual_cost`` and ``actual_carbon`` non-boolean
368	    non-negative integers. Any violation raises ``ValueError`` before a
369	    business file is read.
370	
371	    The six business snapshots are read under shared locks together with
372	    the completion ledger's exclusive lock, all taken in resolved
373	    real-path order; the independent migration advice, intent and
374	    settlement ledgers beside the snapshots are discovered and read
375	    shared as part of the same snapshot, so the registration, a
376	    concurrent clearing or migration decision and a concurrent migration
377	    settlement observe one consistent version.
378	
379	    Only a job in a stable terminal state completes: it must be traded,
380	    its dispatch decision must be ``succeeded``, the corresponding
381	    launch execution plan (the highest-attempt launch plan) must be
382	    ``completed``, and there must be no active migration, no unsettled
383	    terminal migration and no pending migration settlement; the
384	    completion moment must not precede the last recorded execution or
385	    migration evidence. An accepted job outside that predicate raises
386	    ``PermissionError``; an unknown job raises ``KeyError``.
387	
388	    A first success freezes, in order, the job id, the completion
389	    moment, the outcome, the actual figures, the generation and resource
390	    selection :func:`carbon_market.rebalance.current` shows and the
391	    ``cost_exceeded``/``carbon_exceeded`` flags against the job's
392	    original upper bounds, and commits the record, the idempotency
393	    binding and one audit event in a single synced atomic write; the
394	    call returns ``(record, True)``. Replaying the same key with the
395	    same request returns the stored record with ``False`` without
396	    rewriting a byte; the same key bound to another request, or the same
397	    job completed under another key, raises ``ValueError`` and leaves
398	    every ledger untouched. A refused or failed request never creates a
399	    completion record or changes an existing ledger.
400	
401	    Missing input files or the completion ledger parent raise
402	    ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid arguments, a completion moment
403	    earlier than the last evidence, structure, ordering, references or
404	    non-canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; other locking or I/O
405	    failures raise ``OSError``.
406	    """
407	    # Imported lazily: the completion layer sits on top of rebalance and
408	    # must not pull it in at module import time.
409	    from . import rebalance as _rebalance
410	
411	    for value in (jobs, supply, signals, trades, dispatch, execution,
412	                  completions, job_id, key):
413	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
414	            raise ValueError("the seven paths, job_id and key must be "
415	                             "non-empty strings")
416	    if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
417	        raise ValueError("at must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
418	    if outcome not in _OUTCOMES:
419	        raise ValueError("outcome must be succeeded or failed")
420	    if not _is_plain_int(actual_cost) or actual_cost < 0:
421	        raise ValueError("actual_cost must be a non-boolean non-negative "
422	                         "integer")
423	    if not _is_plain_int(actual_carbon) or actual_carbon < 0:
424	        raise ValueError("actual_carbon must be a non-boolean non-negative "
425	                         "integer")
426	
427	    job_real = os.path.realpath(jobs)
428	    supply_real = os.path.realpath(supply)
429	    signal_real = os.path.realpath(signals)
430	    trades_real = os.path.realpath(trades)
431	    dispatch_real = os.path.realpath(dispatch)
432	    execution_real = os.path.realpath(execution)
433	    completion_real = os.path.realpath(completions)
434	    all_paths = (job_real, supply_real, signal_real, trades_real,
435	                 dispatch_real, execution_real, completion_real)
436	    if len(set(all_paths)) != 7:
437	        raise ValueError("the seven paths must be distinct real paths")
438	
439	    store = _get_store(completion_real)
440	    with store.lock:
441	        # The migration lineage and sibling completion ledgers are
442	        # discovered beside the snapshots before any lock is taken, the
443	        # same mechanism evaluate uses for its lineage. The completion
444	        # ledger's own root shape (completions + idempotency) is
445	        # distinct from every lineage shape and is never mistaken for
446	        # one.
447	        discovered = _rebalance._discover_lineage_paths(
448	            all_paths, ("advice", "intent", "settlement"))
449	        lineage_reals = {real for kind in ("advice", "intent", "settlement")
450	                         for real in discovered.get(kind, ())
451	                         if real not in set(all_paths)}
452	        sibling_completions = [
453	            real for real in _market._discover_completion_paths(all_paths)
454	            if real != completion_real]
455	        extra_reals = lineage_reals | set(sibling_completions)
456	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
457	            for locked in sorted(set(all_paths) | extra_reals):
458	                stack.enter_context(
459	                    _lock(locked, shared=(locked != completion_real)))
460	
461	            accepted, job_map, job_events, job_raw = \
462	                _jobs._load_submit_file(job_real)
463	            if job_raw is None:
464	                raise FileNotFoundError(
465	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} does not exist")
466	            if job_raw != _jobs._serialize_submit_file(
467	                    accepted, job_map, job_events):
468	                raise ValueError(
469	                    f"acceptance file {job_real!r} is not in canonical "
470	                    "compact form")
471	            history, _supply_map, _supply_events, supply_raw = \
472	                _resources._load_file(supply_real)
473	            if supply_raw is None:
474	                raise FileNotFoundError(
475	                    f"supply file {supply_real!r} does not exist")
476	            signal_history, _signal_map, _signal_events, signal_raw = \
477	                _signals._load_file(signal_real)
478	            if signal_raw is None:
479	                raise FileNotFoundError(
480	                    f"signal file {signal_real!r} does not exist")
481	            # Every completion ledger beside the snapshots feeds the
482	            # envelope check, this call's target included when it
483	            # already exists; the write itself lands only in the target.
484	            envelope_paths = list(sibling_completions)
485	            if os.path.exists(completion_real):
486	                envelope_paths.append(completion_real)
487	            cleared, _clear_keys, trades_raw = _market._load_clear_ledger(
488	                trades_real, accepted, history, signal_history,
489	                completion_paths=envelope_paths)
490	            if trades_raw is None:
491	                raise FileNotFoundError(
492	                    f"clearing ledger {trades_real!r} does not exist")
493	            decisions, _dispatch_keys, dispatch_events, dispatch_raw = \
494	                _dispatch._load_ledger(dispatch_real)
495	            if dispatch_raw is None:
496	                raise FileNotFoundError(
497	                    f"dispatch ledger {dispatch_real!r} does not exist")
498	            exec_plans, _plan_keys, exec_events = \
499	                _execution._load_existing_ledger(execution_real)[:3]
500	
501	            # Load the discovered lineage exactly in evaluate's
502	            # reference order: advice first (current grounding
503	            # deferred), then the intent ledger, then the settlement
504	            # ledger, and only then ground the advice currents.
505	            snapshot_real_set = set(all_paths)
506	            advice_real = next(
507	                (real for real in discovered.get("advice", ())
508	                 if real not in snapshot_real_set), None)
509	            intent_real = next(
510	                (real for real in discovered.get("intent", ())
511	                 if real not in snapshot_real_set), None)
512	            settlement_real = next(
513	                (real for real in discovered.get("settlement", ())
514	                 if real not in snapshot_real_set), None)
515	            advice_records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
516	            lineage_intents: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
517	            lineage_plans: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
518	            lineage_idempotency: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
519	            lineage_events: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
520	            lineage_version = _rebalance._INTENT_VERSION
521	            if advice_real is not None:
522	                advice_records, _advice_events, _advice_raw = \
523	                    _rebalance._load_ledger(
524	                        advice_real, accepted, cleared, history,
525	                        signal_history, defer_current=True)
526	            if intent_real is not None:
527	                (lineage_intents, lineage_plans, lineage_idempotency,
528	                 lineage_events, lineage_version, _ir) = \
529	                    _rebalance._load_intent_ledger(
530	                        intent_real, accepted, cleared, history,
531	                        signal_history, advice_records)
532	                lineage_plans = _rebalance._plans_by_start_key(
533	                    lineage_plans, lineage_idempotency, lineage_version)
534	            completed_settlements: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
535	            pending_settlements: set[str] = set()
536	            if settlement_real is not None:
537	                s_records, _sid, _sev, _sraw = \
538	                    _rebalance._load_settlement_ledger(
539	                        settlement_real, accepted, cleared, lineage_plans,
540	                        lineage_idempotency, lineage_events,
541	                        lineage_version)
542	                completed_settlements, pending_settlements = \
543	                    _rebalance._lineage_from_settlement_records(s_records)
544	                settlement_currents = _rebalance._settlement_currents(
545	                    completed_settlements)
546	                for advice_record in advice_records.values():
547	                    _rebalance._ground_advice_current(
548	                        advice_record, cleared, settlement_currents)
549	
550	            records, idempotency, events, old_bytes = \
551	                _load_completion_ledger(completion_real, accepted, history)
552	
553	            # Sibling completion ledgers beside the snapshots are part of
554	            # the same completion state: a job already completed in one
555	            # of them cannot be completed again in this one.
556	            sibling_union: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
557	            for sibling_real in sibling_completions:
558	                sibling_records, _sids, _sevents, _sraw = \
559	                    _load_completion_ledger(sibling_real, accepted, history)
560	                for sibling_record in sibling_records.values():
561	                    sibling_union[sibling_record["job_id"]] = sibling_record
562	
563	            request = {"job_id": job_id, "at": at, "outcome": outcome,
564	                       "actual_cost": actual_cost,
565	                       "actual_carbon": actual_carbon}
566	            binding = idempotency.get(key)
567	            if binding is not None:
568	                if binding != request:
569	                    raise ValueError("idempotency key was already used "
570	                                     "with a different request")
571	                # An equivalent replay returns the stored record without
572	                # rechecking the predicate or rewriting a byte.
573	                return copy.deepcopy(records[key]), False
574	
575	            if job_id not in accepted:
576	                raise KeyError(job_id)
577	            if _record_for_job(records, job_id) is not None \
578	                    or job_id in sibling_union:
579	                raise ValueError("the job is already completed under "
580	                                 "another idempotency key")
581	
582	            # Stable-terminal predicate, in one fixed order. Every
583	            # failure to reach a stable terminal state is a
584	            # PermissionError.
585	            trade = cleared.get(job_id)
586	            decision = decisions.get(job_id)
587	            if trade is None or decision is None \
588	                    or decision["state"] != "succeeded":
589	                raise PermissionError("the job is not in a stable terminal "
590	                                      "state")
591	            launch_plans = [plan for plan in
592	                            exec_plans.get(job_id, {}).values()
593	                            if plan["kind"] == "launch"]
594	            if not launch_plans \
595	                    or max(launch_plans,
596	                           key=lambda plan: plan["attempt"])["state"] \
597	                    != "completed":
598	                raise PermissionError("the job's launch execution plan is "
599	                                      "not completed")
600	            job_migration_plans = {
601	                plan_key: plan for plan_key, plan in lineage_plans.items()
602	                if plan["job_id"] == job_id}
603	            if any(plan["state"] == "active"
604	                   for plan in job_migration_plans.values()):
605	                raise PermissionError("the job still has an active "
606	                                      "migration")
607	            if job_id in pending_settlements:
608	                raise PermissionError("the job still holds a pending "
609	                                      "migration settlement")
610	            # A reservation never claimed by a plan still holds target
611	            # capacity and keeps the job outside a stable terminal
612	            # state.
613	            claimed_refs = _rebalance._claimed_intent_refs(
614	                lineage_plans, lineage_idempotency, lineage_version)
615	            if any(ref not in claimed_refs
616	                   for ref, intent_record
617	                   in _rebalance._job_intent_items(lineage_intents,
618	                                                   lineage_version, job_id)):
619	                raise PermissionError("the job still holds an open "
620	                                      "migration reservation")
621	            settled_plan_keys = {
622	                record["plan_key"]
623	                for record in completed_settlements.get(job_id, ())
624	                if record["state"] in _rebalance._SETTLE_FINAL_STATES}
625	            for plan_key in job_migration_plans:
626	                if plan_key not in settled_plan_keys:
627	                    raise PermissionError("a terminal migration is not "
628	                                          "settled yet")
629	
630	            # The completion moment must not precede the last relevant
631	            # execution or migration evidence: step receipts and
632	            # execution recoveries in the execution ledger, every
633	            # reservation, claim, migration step and recovery in the
634	            # intent ledger, and the completed settlement moments.
635	            evidence = 0
636	            for attempt_plan in exec_plans.get(job_id, {}).values():
637	                for receipt in attempt_plan["steps"]:
638	                    evidence = max(evidence, receipt["at"])
639	            for event in exec_events.values():
640	                request_event = event["request"]
641	                if request_event.get("job_id") == job_id \
642	                        and request_event.get("action") in ("record",
643	                                                            "recover"):
644	                    evidence = max(evidence, request_event["at"])
645	            # A dispatch decision can also reach succeeded/failed
646	            # through a direct finish outside execution_sync; that finish
647	            # moment is terminal evidence too.
648	            for event in dispatch_events.values():
649	                request_event = event["request"]
650	                if request_event.get("job_id") == job_id \
651	                        and request_event.get("action") == "finish":
652	                    evidence = max(evidence, request_event["at"])
653	            for event in lineage_events.values():
654	                if event["request"].get("job_id") == job_id:
655	                    evidence = max(evidence, event["request"]["at"])
656	            for settlement in completed_settlements.get(job_id, ()):
657	                evidence = max(evidence, settlement["at"])
658	            if at < evidence:
659	                raise ValueError("completion moment must not precede the "
660	                                 "last execution or migration evidence")
661	
662	            # Freeze exactly what rebalance.current shows from this
663	            # snapshot: the highest-generation completed settlement's
664	            # after-binding, otherwise the immutable trade.
665	            latest_settled = _rebalance._latest_completed_binding(
666	                completed_settlements, job_id)
667	            if latest_settled is not None:
668	                generation = latest_settled["generation"]
669	                current = copy.deepcopy(latest_settled["after"])
670	            else:
671	                generation = 0
672	                current = {"resource_id": trade["resource_id"],
673	                           "version": trade["version"]}
674	
675	            job = accepted[job_id]
676	            record: dict[str, Any] = {
677	                "job_id": job_id,
678	                "at": at,
679	                "outcome": outcome,
680	                "actual_cost": actual_cost,
681	                "actual_carbon": actual_carbon,
682	                "generation": generation,
683	                "current": current,
684	                "cost_exceeded": actual_cost > job["max_cost"],
685	                "carbon_exceeded": actual_carbon > job["carbon_cap"],
686	            }
687	            # Full independent validation against the snapshot before
688	            # the commit is accepted.
689	            _validate_record(record, accepted, history)
690	            records[key] = record
691	            idempotency[key] = dict(request)
692	            events[key] = {"key": key, "request": dict(request),
693	                           "result": copy.deepcopy(record)}
694	            _commit_file(completion_real,
695	                         _canonical_bytes(records, idempotency, events),
696	                         old_bytes)
697	            return copy.deepcopy(record), True
698	
699	
700	def get(completions: str, job_id: str) -> dict[str, object]:
701	    """Return the recorded completion for ``job_id``.
702	
703	    ``completions`` and ``job_id`` must be non-empty strings, else
704	    ``ValueError``. The completion ledger is read under its shared lock
705	    and never modified. A job that was never completed -- an unknown job
706	    id, a job without a record or a missing completion ledger -- raises
707	    ``KeyError(job_id)``; invalid structure, ordering or non-canonical
708	    bytes raise ``ValueError``; other locking or I/O failures raise
709	    ``OSError``. The returned dict is a fresh copy in the record's
710	    fixed field order.
711	    """
712	    for value in (completions, job_id):
713	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
714	            raise ValueError("completions and job_id must be non-empty "
715	                             "strings")
716	
717	    realpath = os.path.realpath(completions)
718	    with _lock(realpath, shared=True):
719	        records, _idempotency, _events, _raw = _load_completion_ledger(
720	            realpath)
721	    record = _record_for_job(records, job_id)
722	    if record is None:
723	        raise KeyError(job_id)
724	    return copy.deepcopy(record)
725	
726	
727	def _validate_search_arguments(
728	    completions: str,
729	    cursor: str | None,
730	    limit: int,
731	    outcome: str | None,
732	    exceeded: str | None,
733	) -> None:
734	    if not isinstance(completions, str) or not completions:
735	        raise ValueError("completions must be a non-empty string")
736	    if cursor is not None and (not isinstance(cursor, str) or not cursor):
737	        raise ValueError("cursor must be None or a non-empty string")
738	    # bool is a subclass of int and must be rejected as a page size.
739	    if not isinstance(limit, int) or isinstance(limit, bool) \
740	            or not 1 <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT:
741	        raise ValueError("limit must be an integer between 1 and 1000")
742	    if outcome is not None and outcome not in _OUTCOMES:
743	        raise ValueError("outcome filter must be succeeded or failed")
744	    if exceeded is not None and exceeded not in _EXCEEDED_FILTERS:
745	        raise ValueError("exceeded filter must be cost, carbon, any or "
746	                         "none")
747	
748	
749	def _matches(record: dict[str, Any], outcome: str | None,
750	             exceeded: str | None) -> bool:
751	    if outcome is not None and record["outcome"] != outcome:
752	        return False
753	    if exceeded == "cost":
754	        return record["cost_exceeded"]
755	    if exceeded == "carbon":
756	        return record["carbon_exceeded"]
757	    if exceeded == "any":
758	        return record["cost_exceeded"] or record["carbon_exceeded"]
759	    if exceeded == "none":
760	        return not record["cost_exceeded"] \
761	            and not record["carbon_exceeded"]
762	    return True
763	
764	
765	def _page(
766	    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
767	    cursor: str | None,
768	    limit: int,
769	    outcome: str | None,
770	    exceeded: str | None,
771	) -> dict[str, Any]:
772	    # The scan order is the job id's code-point order, not the ledger's
773	    # idempotency-key order. The filters are applied first and the
774	    # exclusive cursor then selects from the filtered sequence; one
775	    # extra match is collected to learn whether the page is the last.
776	    ordered = sorted((record["job_id"], record)
777	                     for record in records.values())
778	    matches: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
779	    for job_id, record in ordered:
780	        if not _matches(record, outcome, exceeded):
781	            continue
782	        if cursor is not None and job_id <= cursor:
783	            continue
784	        matches.append({"job_id": job_id,
785	                        "record": copy.deepcopy(record)})
786	        if len(matches) > limit:
787	            break
788	
789	    if len(matches) > limit:
790	        page = matches[:limit]
791	        next_cursor: str | None = page[-1]["job_id"]
792	    else:
793	        page = matches
794	        next_cursor = None
795	    return {"entries": page, "next": next_cursor}
796	
797	
798	def search(completions: str, cursor: str | None = None,
799	           limit: int = _DEFAULT_LIMIT, outcome: str | None = None,
800	           exceeded: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
801	    """Return one page of completion records matching the given filters.
802	
803	    ``completions`` must be a non-empty string. ``cursor`` is ``None``
804	    or a non-empty string -- it need not name a recorded job -- and only
805	    records whose job id is strictly greater than it in code-point order
806	    are considered. ``limit`` is the page size: an integer from 1 to
807	    1000 (booleans are rejected), defaulting to 100. ``outcome`` is
808	    ``None``, ``"succeeded"`` or ``"failed"``; ``exceeded`` is ``None``
809	    or one of ``"cost"`` (the cost budget was exceeded), ``"carbon"``
810	    (the carbon budget was exceeded), ``"any"`` (at least one budget was
811	    exceeded) and ``"none"`` (neither was). Both filters combine by
812	    logical AND and the cursor selects from the filtered sequence. Any
813	    other value raises ``ValueError``.
814	
815	    The records are scanned in ascending job-id code-point order.
816	    Returns ``{"entries": [{"job_id": ..., "record": ...}, ...],
817	    "next": cursor_or_none}``: each record is a fresh copy in the
818	    record's fixed field order, and ``next`` is the job id of the page's
819	    last entry when further matching records remain, else ``None``. With
820	    no matching records the page is empty and ``next`` is ``None``.
821	
822	    The ledger is validated, filtered and paginated as one snapshot
823	    while its shared lock is held, and the query never writes. A missing
824	    completion ledger raises ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid structure,
825	    ordering or non-canonical bytes raise ``ValueError``; any other
826	    locking or I/O failure raises ``OSError``.
827	    """
828	    _validate_search_arguments(completions, cursor, limit, outcome,
829	                               exceeded)
830	
831	    realpath = os.path.realpath(completions)
832	    with _lock(realpath, shared=True):
833	        records, _idempotency, _events, raw = _load_completion_ledger(
834	            realpath)
835	        if raw is None:
836	            raise FileNotFoundError(
837	                f"completion ledger {realpath!r} does not exist")
838	        return _page(records, cursor, limit, outcome, exceeded)
839	
840	
841	def _is_digest(value: object) -> bool:
842	    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 \
843	        and all(char in _HEX_DIGITS for char in value)
844	
845	
846	def _validate_condition(condition: str | None) -> None:
847	    if condition is not None and not _is_digest(condition):
848	        raise ValueError("condition must be None or a 64-digit lowercase "
849	                         "hexadecimal digest")
850	
851	
852	def _respond(payload: Any, condition: str | None
853	             ) -> tuple[bytes | None, str]:
854	    # Serialize, digest and compare while the caller holds the ledger's
855	    # shared lock: the tag summarizes exactly the bytes a 200 would
856	    # serve and both come from the same complete ledger version. The
857	    # body is the endpoint's compact UTF-8 JSON -- compact separators,
858	    # non-ASCII written through, no trailing newline.
859	    body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
860	                      allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
861	    etag = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
862	    if condition is not None and condition == etag:
863	        return None, etag
864	    return body, etag
865	
866	
867	def get_response(completions: str, job_id: str,
868	                 condition: str | None = None
869	                 ) -> tuple[bytes | None, str]:
870	    """Read one job's completion as a conditional, HTTP-ready response.
871	
872	    ``completions`` and ``job_id`` follow :func:`get`; ``condition`` is
873	    ``None`` or a single 64-digit lowercase hexadecimal digest -- the
874	    tag a previous response carried, without its quotes. The ledger is
875	    read under its shared lock and the record object is formed,
876	    serialized to the response's compact UTF-8 JSON bytes and digested
877	    while the lock is held, so a completion racing the query is observed
878	    as either the complete old ledger or the complete new one and the
879	    tag always summarizes the bytes of one version.
880	
881	    Returns ``(None, etag)`` when ``condition`` equals the current
882	    tag -- the endpoint answers 304 with an empty body and the same
883	    tag -- and ``(body, etag)`` otherwise. Unlike :func:`get`, a missing
884	    completion ledger raises ``FileNotFoundError`` so the endpoint can
885	    tell it apart from an unknown job, which raises ``KeyError``;
886	    invalid arguments or an invalid ledger raise ``ValueError`` and any
887	    other locking or I/O failure raises ``OSError``.
888	    """
889	    for value in (completions, job_id):
890	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
891	            raise ValueError("completions and job_id must be non-empty "
892	                             "strings")
893	    _validate_condition(condition)
894	
895	    realpath = os.path.realpath(completions)
896	    with _lock(realpath, shared=True):
897	        records, _idempotency, _events, raw = _load_completion_ledger(
898	            realpath)
899	        if raw is None:
900	            raise FileNotFoundError(
901	                f"completion ledger {realpath!r} does not exist")
902	        record = _record_for_job(records, job_id)
903	        if record is None:
904	            raise KeyError(job_id)
905	        return _respond(copy.deepcopy(record), condition)
906	
907	
908	def search_response(completions: str, cursor: str | None = None,
909	                    limit: int = _DEFAULT_LIMIT, outcome: str | None = None,
910	                    exceeded: str | None = None,
911	                    condition: str | None = None
912	                    ) -> tuple[bytes | None, str]:
913	    """Read one page as a conditional, HTTP-ready response.
914	
915	    The filters follow :func:`search` and ``condition`` follows
916	    :func:`get_response`. The page object is formed, serialized and
917	    digested under the ledger's shared lock, so any visible record,
918	    order or cursor change changes the tag and a racing completion is
919	    observed as one complete ledger version. Returns ``(None, etag)``
920	    on a conditional hit and ``(body, etag)`` otherwise; the error
921	    mapping is :func:`search`'s.
922	    """
923	    _validate_search_arguments(completions, cursor, limit, outcome,
924	                               exceeded)
925	    _validate_condition(condition)
926	
927	    realpath = os.path.realpath(completions)
928	    with _lock(realpath, shared=True):
929	        records, _idempotency, _events, raw = _load_completion_ledger(
930	            realpath)
931	        if raw is None:
932	            raise FileNotFoundError(
933	                f"completion ledger {realpath!r} does not exist")
934	        return _respond(_page(records, cursor, limit, outcome, exceeded),
935	                        condition)
